Define runtime-validated request/result/error schemas shared across server and renderer: sourceBinding/ref, schemaRevision, typed filterAST/sorts/field IDs, aggregation requests, evaluationTime/IANA timezone, page bound and opaque cursor; rows retain Rox2EntityRef, source revision and field capability/value states. risks: Flat actor grants, project readable flags, entity capability catalog and surface context are not authoritative per-row/per-field policy; wrapping them as Base ACL leaks data.
Current unrestricted full-text filtering before ACL leaks through matches, denied property predicates, sort order, links, summary counts or error titles even if result rows are later hidden.
4000-note/2MiB limits, unreadable files and unavailable bun:sqlite can yield incomplete data or [] today; authorized totals need explicit source completeness/failure diagnostics.

Path-derived note IDs are not independently guaranteed stable across renames; LSX-WP-009/native binding owner must establish authoritative ref mapping rather than treating display paths as foreign keys.
Non-unique updatedAt/title order and mutable source enumeration are insufficient for page consistency; tie-break must use full scoped EntityRef and cursor/source/policy generation fence.
Policy changes must be checked before cached return and across asynchronous source reads; fs.watch alone cannot observe revoke, and actor-only cache keys cannot distinguish policy epochs.
Published RS-BASE-01 has older source revision, alternate proposed paths and RS-DRV-01 prerequisite; preserve the normative LSX owned files while reconciling shared foundation readiness with lead.
Current write scope lacks real RPC/renderer/localization/event authority patches; source-only implementation and an isolated UI test cannot satisfy all seven views or actual toolbar DoD.

Typed fields/evaluation/derived relations are required inputs but their exact interfaces are not delivered in inspected package; do not create duplicate field registry, formula engine, auth or row store.
hashVaultMarkdownFiles is a bounded projection/readback helper, not transactional source snapshot, permission epoch or durable native receipt; mixed file reads require owner fences.
Concurrent root integration can stale any whole-file evidence; preflight validity is generation-specific and never feature completion.
